reviewer: root implementation self-review, not independent replication
findings: AttnKV and AttnKVF32 contain only key/value arrays; validity comes from transformer t. The next token overwrites slot0 before attention consumes prefix[0,1); each subsequent valid slot is overwritten before first use. Old KV bytes therefore need not match at reset.
Each KdaState has S, ring, pos and padding. Boundary serialization includes every S/ring/pos value; padding is excluded. All rings and pos reset to zero in every arm.
The six per-token skip_store rows are each overwritten in layers0..5 before corresponding reads in layers6..11 of the same token; they carry no authoritative inter-token history.
The next step refreshes prior_f32 from the same causal PPM distribution, zeros its pads, and overwrites token/layer scratch before use; immutable weights are separately hash-bound.

Only the reset method and diagnostic coder instrumentation change. Other native models keep original deterministic initialization and decoded-bit update order. Their equality is a source-based induction argument plus full probability/coder evidence, not a complete native-memory serialization.
No corpus outcome is inferred by this source review. Native encode/decode/repeat and guard evidence remain required.
